comparison.objective: Open a push-in terminal with an operating tool, insert a bare stranded wire, and remove the tool; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Concurrent terminal actuation and compliant wire insertion versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammer impact, fracture regulation, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Wire retained in the terminal after tool removal versus four tangs fractured, inserts retained, and fragments physically contained.
comparison.reason: This is the closest precision tool-and-recess comparison, but it tests connector actuation and insertion, while the candidate tests impact-induced notch fracture and free-fragment recovery. Detailed wire retention and damage thresholds are not stated.
